sections.title: In brief
sections.text: A formal model of stylistic change is applied to De Stijl painting, specifically works by Georges Vantongerloo and Fritz Glarner.

sections.title: Question or aim
sections.text: How can transformations of a style be described through a formal design-language framework?

sections.title: Approach described
sections.text: The abstract identifies a comparative formal analysis of two artists’ paintings.

sections.title: What the abstract supports
sections.text: It establishes the paper’s subject and analytical approach; it does not state the individual transformation rules or detailed conclusions.

sections.text: Only the official abstract and bibliography were read. The paintings selected, diagrammatic decompositions and historical interpretation remain unverified here.

sections.title: Why it may help
